testcase.name: every unsafe role attribute aborts the session before anything else runs()
TLS is verify-full with host-name verification, never require()
the role check runs on every connection - a role that turns superuser later is caught on its next session()
row limit, paging and statement timeout are applied by the executor()
a session is read-only, warmed up and verified before the caller's statement, and always rolled back and closed()
a denied literal address blocks every name that resolves to it()
discovery and the connection test use the same checked session as queries()
the production policy refuses to be built from a missing or unreadable platform URL()
a denied host whose address cannot be determined blocks the connection instead of being skipped()
driver properties carry the limits, the pinned address and the credential - the URL carries none of them()
JDBC URLs are read completely - failover lists, userinfo, IPv6 and implied localhost()
